title: グランドライブ、スタート！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It was anything but smooth sailing to get here, but the Grand Concert is finally upon us. The different stages are already seeing tremendous crowds.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But we're just getting started. Next up is "Girls' Legend U."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I exchange a few words with <chrname> before sending her onstage. The whole venue is in for a fun time!
